news.headline: Real estate firm Assetz gets Sebi nod to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO
news.summary: Assetz Ltd has obtained approval from Sebi to proceed with its plans for an initial public offering. The company aims to raise around Rs 1,200 crore in this IPO process. Assetz has developed a substantial land bank and project pipeline to meet housing demand in Bengaluru. With strong backing from investors like AGP Partners, the firm is expanding its presence in key markets.

news.headline: India bonds reverse intraday gains to end lower as profit booking takes center stage
news.summary: Indian government bonds faced a setback as profit-seeking traders reacted to earlier gains, with the benchmark bond yield increasing to 7.2858% compared to the previous closure. The fluctuations in crude prices have influenced the market outlook on the Reserve Bank of India, prompting analysts to predict a potential rate increase in December amidst rising retail inflation.

news.headline: Anthropic IPO: Why Wall Street is betting big on Claude AI maker
news.summary: Anthropic is preparing for a blockbuster IPO that could value the Claude AI maker at up to $1.6 trillion. Strong investor demand, strategic stakes held by Amazon and Google, and bullish analyst forecasts are driving interest, although governance and profitability risks remain.

news.headline: Max Healthcare among 10 Nifty stocks rallied up to 22% in 1 month. Did you miss the rally?
news.summary: Nifty has surged impressively, claiming the title of the top-performing major equity market lately. Max Healthcare Institute reported a striking gain of almost 22% over the past month. InterGlobe Aviation and Mahindra & Mahindra followed suit with increases of approximately 20% and 17% respectively. The State Bank of India, a prominent public-sector entity, saw an uplift of about 15% as well.

news.headline: PSBs' net profit rises 17% to Rs 1.10 lakh cr in H1 FY27; business crosses Rs 300 lakh crore
news.summary: Public sector banks in India have reported a remarkable 16.9 percent rise in net profits during the first half of this fiscal year, reflecting a thriving financial environment. With total business reaching Rs 301.6 lakh crore, and a notable drop in the gross non-performing assets ratio to an unprecedented 1.69 percent, the banks are demonstrating improved stability.

news.headline: PI Industries among 5 stocks hitting 52-week low; slipped up to 26% in a month
news.summary: Five BSE 500 stocks, including PI Industries, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail and Thermax, hit fresh 52-week lows as the market weakened, with losses reaching 26% in a month.

news.headline: Nasdaq gains in choppy trade as Nvidia outlook lifts AI mood; Anthropic pricing awaited
news.summary: Amidst a choppy trading session, the Nasdaq enjoyed a boost from Nvidia's positive revenue guidance, which alleviated some market apprehensions. Conversely, the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 stumbled, affected by falling stock values in finance and healthcare. Investors are now focused on Anthropic's upcoming IPO, which could signal the market’s enthusiasm for AI ventures.

news.headline: Prestige Group buys 50 pc stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for Rs 500 cr
news.summary: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd has successfully acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for an estimated Rs 500 crore. This partnership is set to develop a commercial project in Andheri, Mumbai, spanning 21,978.22 square meters, with projected leasable space of 1.50 million square feet. The total project valuation is forecasted at approximately Rs 4,500 crore, marking a significant expansion for Prestige in the Mumbai real estate market.

news.headline: Market Trading Guide: Deepak Fertilisers among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday
news.summary: Indian equity benchmarks declined amid weak global cues and profit booking, with the Nifty falling 0.63% and Sensex 0.61%. Choice Broking's Sachin Gupta recommended three stocks—Vijaya, Eureka Forbes and Deepak Fertilisers—with bullish technical setups and defined targets.

news.headline: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at Nov 23 board meeting
news.summary: Dalmia Bharat, India's fourth-largest cement manufacturer, will hold a board meeting on November 23. The meeting will focus on a proposal for a buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. Specific details regarding the buyback size, price, and number of shares have not been disclosed yet. The company also plans to expand its cement capacity to 75 million tonnes per annum by FY28.

news.headline: Gateway Distriparks to operate, manage common rail yard terminal at JNPA
news.summary: Gateway Distriparks Limited has gained a mandate for operating the common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. This terminal will enhance the handling of container trains and improve the efficiency of cargo movement. The contract spans eight years, focusing on train handling, container stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. Gateway aims to work closely with JNPA to improve rail connectivity for trade.

news.headline: Kotak MF, BlackRock, others buy stake worth Rs 1,905 cr in Groww
news.summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund (MF) led the buying spree, acquiring 2.05 crore shares or a 0.33 per cent stake, for Rs 448.95 crore, making it the biggest buyer in the transaction.

news.headline: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
news.summary: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

news.headline: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
news.summary: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.

news.headline: Target reports strongest quarterly sales gain in five years heading into the holiday shopping season
news.summary: Target reported a 7.1% increase in net sales for the third quarter, reaching $27.07 billion. The growth was attributed to a revitalized product lineup, expanded same-day deliveries, and price cuts. CEO Michael Fiddelke indicated that the sales momentum was observed across various income groups. The company aims to enhance clothing and home goods offerings while working on women's apparel and footwear.
